title: The offset planet on its carrier
intent: Track the gear body and the supported axle in the front frame.

choices.reason: In the carrier frame the fixed sun turns counterclockwise, so the planet turns clockwise relative to the arm. Adding the clockwise arm motion preserves clockwise spin.
Using the external-mesh sign directly in the stationary frame reverses the predicted spin.
The tooth at contact is instantaneously at rest, but the entire planet gear is not.
The axle is supported by the clockwise arm and follows its orbit.
